episodes.title: The Galaxy Being
episodes.summary: Engineer Allen Maxwell draws power from his brother's radio station to contact an alien explorer in a distant galaxy. However, when the transmission is overloaded, the Being is transported to Earth with disasterous results.

episodes.title: The Hundred Days of the Dragon
episodes.summary: An Asian despot successfully infiltrates an imposter for an American Presidential candidate... and the imposter is elected President.

episodes.title: The Architects of Fear
episodes.summary: A group of scientists choose one of their number to be surgically altered into an alien so that he'll scare the nations of the world into cooperating before the Doomsday Clock strikes midnight.

episodes.title: The Sixth Finger
episodes.summary: A Welsh miner volunteers for an experiment to advance him 20,000 years up the evolutionary ladder.

episodes.title: The Man Who Was Never Born
episodes.summary: A mutant from a doomed future travels back in time to the present day, to stop the series of events that lead to his world. However, he falls in the love with the fiancee of the man he intends to kill.

episodes.title: O.B.I.T.
episodes.summary: A senator conducts a hearing into a murder at a Military Department research center, and soon uncovers a conspiracy intended to demoralize humans and prepare them for alien invasion.

episodes.title: The Human Factor
episodes.summary: A psychiatrist at a U.S. military base in Greenland uses an experimental procedure to explore the mind of an unstable soldier... and the two switch minds.

episodes.title: Corpus Earthling
episodes.summary: After he's concussed in a lab accident, surgeon Paul Cameron hears two nearby rocks discussing their plans to conquer Earth.

episodes.title: Nightmare
episodes.summary: In the war between the planets Ebon and Earth, the Ebonites capture several enemy prisoners and put them through a series of grotesque tortures to determine what they know.

episodes.title: It Crawled Out of the Woodwork
episodes.summary: An unstoppable and insatiable energy cloud is created at a physics center in California... and the director attempts to control it no matter the cost in human life.

episodes.title: The Borderland
episodes.summary: A scientist seeks to create a doorway between dimensions, and asks an industrial CEO to finance his experiments and provide the electrical power necessary.

episodes.title: Tourist Attraction
episodes.summary: In South America a U.S businessman and adventurer captures a humanoid ichthyosaur, and the local dictator plans to use it to bring tourists to the area. However, the creature--and a school of creatures like it--have plans of their own.

episodes.title: The Zanti Misfits
episodes.summary: Alien beings, the Zanti, send their criminals to Earth because they are morally opposed to killing them. They instruct the U.S.military not to approach the Zanti spacecraft... but a man and woman break through the cordon, risking the destruction of Earth.

episodes.title: The Mice
episodes.summary: Life inmate Chino Rivera volunteers for a teleportation experiment as scientists make contact with an alien planet ten years away, and whose inhabitants want to exchange high-ranking officials ... once they exchange test subjects to make sure the teleportation process works.

episodes.title: Controlled Experiment
episodes.summary: Two undercover Martians use a time-control device to analyze the quaint human custom of murder.

episodes.title: Don't Open Till Doomsday
episodes.summary: In 1929, a local scientist delivers a mysterious present to newlyweds, with the note "Don't Open Till Doomsday" on it. The groom Harvey Jr. disappears shortly thereafter, and his bride Mary waits over 35 years until a new set of newlyweds comes along.

episodes.title: ZZZZZ
episodes.summary: A swarm of bees transform its queen into a human female so that she can mate with an entomologist studying them and conquer the world.

episodes.title: The Invisibles
episodes.summary: Alien parasites plan the conquest of Earth by attaching themselves to the spinal columns of men in power. They recruit disaffected loners to spread their infection... unaware that one of the loners is a government agent sent to infiltrate them.

episodes.title: The Bellero Shield
episodes.summary: When Judith Bellero's father-in-law refuses to grant her scientist husband--Richard Jr.--control of his company, Judith sees a way to win Richard acclaim by murdering an alien that he accidentally summoned to Earth and claiming that Richard invented the protective shield device it wears.

episodes.title: The Children of Spider County
episodes.summary: Four scientists have disappeared, and the Space Security Agency discovers that they all were born in a small town in Spider Country and are extraordinary physical and mental speciments... and a fifth man meeting the same criteria is still there and being held on a murder charge.

episodes.title: Specimen: Unknown
episodes.summary: A five-man space station crew encounter an outer space plant... which spreads with amazing speed and emits poison spores that slowly kill the people that encounter them.

episodes.title: Second Chance
episodes.summary: An alien from a doomed world converts an amusement park spaceship into a working model and abducts seven people to save his planet.

episodes.title: Moonstone
episodes.summary: A moonbase expedition takes in alien refugees who are faced with opponents of vastly superior power.

episodes.title: The Mutant
episodes.summary: Psychiatrist Evan Marshall is sent to investigate disturbing reports from an expeditionary team on a small planet.. and discovers that one of the team members has mutated into a radioactive humanoid whose touch is fatal and whose telepathy protects him from any attack.

episodes.title: The Guests
episodes.summary: A drifter finds an old man dying by he side of the road and goes to a nearby house to seek help... and discovers that he and the guests can't leave.

episodes.title: Fun and Games
episodes.summary: A crook and a divorced wife are abducted from Earth to participate in a battle of life and death against two aliens. The stakes: the winners' planet will be spared while the other is destroyed as entertainment for the aliens responsible for the game.

episodes.title: The Special One
episodes.summary: A mysterious tutor shows up at the apartment of a mentally-gifted boy and says that he's with the government, but the father soon realizes that things don't add up.

episodes.title: A Feasibility Study
episodes.summary: An alien race teleports away six square blocks of a city in the hopes that they can use the residents as slaves.

episodes.title: Production and Decay of Strange Particles
episodes.summary: Exposing a quasi-stellar sample to nuclear radiation opens a crack between universes, allowing entities from another dimension to enter this world, infuse the suits of the workers, disintegrate their bodies, and animate the suits. Now the beings intend to set off a nuclear explosion to widen the crack.

episodes.title: The Chameleon
episodes.summary: A government assassin is given a unique assignment: undergo alien DNA grafts to "become" an alien, infiltrate their ship which crashed on Earth, and find out if they pose a threat.

episodes.title: The Forms of Things Unknown
episodes.summary: Two women poison their blackmailing lover Andre and then haul the body away. They end up at the mansion of Tone Hobart, a demented scientist who believes that he's found a way to "tilt" time and bring the dead back to life.

episodes.title: Soldier
episodes.summary: A soldier from a future Earth is blasted back through time to the present day and must learn how his new world works. Meanwhile, his opposite number also travels back in time.

episodes.title: Cold Hands, Warm Heart
episodes.summary: An astronaut returns from a one-man expedition to Venus with an insatiable craving for heat, and begins transforming into an alien life form.

episodes.title: Behold Eck!
episodes.summary: After making special pairs of glasses out of meteorite material, an optical scientist sees a two-dimensional energy being that has become trapped in the third dimension. He then tries to help the creature to get home.

episodes.title: Expanding Human
episodes.summary: A doctor's experiments with mind altering drugs leads to a changed body and consciousness as he starts using more and more of his brain.

episodes.title: Demon with a Glass Hand
episodes.summary: A man named Trent travels from future Earth to the present via a time mirror. Aliens who have invaded Earth come after him, seeking the secrets of Trent's glass hand... which will reveal where Earth's population has disappeared to.

episodes.title: Cry of Silence
episodes.summary: When a couple goes to look at where they will be buying a new farm to move to, they accidentally hit a rock, then start to have encounters with very strange tumbleweeds.

episodes.title: The Invisible Enemy
episodes.summary: On a world of unending sand, Earth astronauts are picked off one by one by an unseen killer.

episodes.title: Wolf 359
episodes.summary: Scientists create a miniature replica of Wolf 359 in the laboratory to test its potential for terraforming, and get unexpected results.

episodes.title: I, Robot
episodes.summary: A sentient robot is put on trial for the crime of murder.

episodes.title: The Inheritors (1)
episodes.summary: Four soldiers come back to military bases wounded in the head by bullets, it is discovered that each of the four men have a second set of brain waves. The men then vanish off the military base and the U.S. government tries to find out what they are up to.

episodes.title: The Inheritors (2)
episodes.summary: Minns gathers several handicapped children and the men's project continues, as the government agents try to stop their plans.

episodes.title: Keeper of the Purple Twilight
episodes.summary: A alien offers advance knowledge to a scientist in exchange for his various emotions that the alien knows nothing about.

episodes.title: The Duplicate Man
episodes.summary: A scientist sends an illegally-created duplicate of himself to destroy a dangerous alien Megasoid on the loose.

episodes.title: Counterweight
episodes.summary: Six subjects undertake a simulated space flight to determine if the months in isolation of a real trip to the target planet of Antheon are psychologically and emotionally endurable. They're unaware that someone--or something--in the simulation intends them to fail.

episodes.title: The Brain of Colonel Barham
episodes.summary: An experiment to use a human brain to control and direct a future flight to another world is undertaken for a developing space project. Colonel Barham, who has been gravely crippled in the past and is dying of a disease, volunteers for the project to his brain as a merging of human and machine. However things go awry as unexpected consequences of the project occur.

episodes.title: The Premonition
episodes.summary: Air force test pilot Jim Darcy crashes and discovers that everyone is in a time warp except for him and his wife Linda. They investigate the local air force base Jim is stationed out of and discover a terrible event is about to happen that will affect both their lives.

episodes.title: The Probe
episodes.summary: A charter plane crashes in the eye of a hurricane... and the passengers find themselves inside a giant alien space probe.
